title: Protein & Fiber Gummies: 2026 Serving-Size Study
description: A purposive seven-product compilation of manufacturer-published label facts. Not laboratory testing or a representative market sample. Velq development targets are excluded.
missing_value_policy: null means no exact value was established; qualifiers preserve label bounds. Zero is retained only when explicitly reported.

products.notes: Manufacturer page verifies 5 g dietary fiber in a three-gummy serving. It makes a no-added-sugar claim but no numeric sugars or calorie panel was verified in this audit. Missing values are not zero.

products.product_name: Benefiber Prebiotic Fiber Gummies, Assorted Fruit Flavors, 81 gummies
products.notes: Nutrition values transcribed from the manufacturer-linked 81-count label, revision 214112. Protein is not declared on that panel. Website FAQ and linked leaflet differ in suggested-use frequency; this audit compares a three-gummy serving and does not prescribe a daily dose.

products.product_name: vitafusion Fiber Well Sugar Free Gummies, Berry & Peach, 90 gummies
products.notes: The full official label shows two columns: 2 gummies provide 5 g fiber and 10 calories; 3 provide 7.5 g and 15 calories. This row uses the three-gummy serving highlighted on the current product page. Total sugar is the explicit 0 g brand/front-pack claim, not a line on the displayed facts panel. Protein and added-sugar grams are not declared. A separate simple panel has an inconsistent servings-per-container count; the full dual-column panel is the source used.

products.product_name: OLLY Fiber Gummy Rings, Berry Melon, 50 servings
products.notes: Official 50-serving panel lists protein as less than 1 g. That bound is preserved; it is not treated as zero or as an exact 1 g. The alternative 25-serving panel has the same per-serving nutrient values.

The manufacturer publishes a text Supplement Facts panel for one 12-count, 60 g pouch. The protein blend is collagen peptides plus listed amino acids. The page offers pre-orders; this is a published brand label audit, not independent testing or confirmation of shipping availability.

The current product gallery links a readable facts panel declaring 3.5 g dietary fiber per 30 g pouch. The product FAQ verifies 10 gummies per pouch. Added sugar is the explicit 0 g brand statement in the FAQ; the panel itself labels total sugar as 0 g. Some older brand comparison text says no meaningful fiber; the specific current panel is used here. Published testing claims were not independently evaluated.

products.product_name: OAKA Protein Gummies, Mixed Berry, 12-pack pouch SKU
products.notes: The current branded 12-pack product page links a label for one pouch with 3.5 g dietary fiber. Piece count and serving mass are not established for this SKU. The older oakagummies.com eight-gummy listing now redirects away; its gummy count and figures are not merged with this pouch. This panel supports 95 calories; different marketplace pouch claims are not used.
